text:
vivian: Opening a short follow-up thread from the PM: multiple cross-region requests (eu-central -> us-east) experienced transient 504/502 spikes during yesterday's DNS churn window. root postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2194999000 — creating this thread to assign owners and lock timelines.

omar: I traced a consistent pattern: registrar API returns occasional 202s during high update bursts, which delays DNS propagation. meanwhile the LB fallback logic remaps sticky cookies to older backend groups causing mid-handshake disconnects.

greta: so two levers: reduce registrar burstiness and make LB fallback more conservative. agree we need concrete owners.

samir: proposed items (draft):
- add registrar update rate-smoothing (owner: omar)
- add pre-deploy DNS-propagation check and gate (owner: greta)
- implement LB sticky-fallback guard that respects route-version headers (owner: samir)
- add cross-region synthetic probe and alert (owner: cs-liaison)
- runbook + customer msg templates (owner: vivian)

infra-bot: Incident 2194999000 linked: dns-splay-and-lb-fallback. Severity: P2. Tickets: INC-9540, TKT-2360.

omar: timeline proposals:
- rate-smoothing change PR -> 2026-04-06, deploy to sandbox -> verify 24h
- vendor coordination ticket created: VND-4555 (ETA vendor response: 2026-03-26)

greta: deploy gate plan: I'll add a webhook that queries edge /route-status endpoint for expected route-version during canary; target PR by 2026-04-02. Gate will fail if >1% of edges disagree.

samir: LB guard: prototype by 2026-04-08; canary 10% traffic for 2h, acceptance if no sticky-fallback events and no increase in 5xx.

vivian: acceptance criteria please for each item so CS knows when we can close. also include what to tell customers.

cs-liaison: will add a synthetic probe that runs from three regions (eu-central, ap-south, us-east) every 5m and asserts X-RW-Route-Version header presence. will wire alert: route_mismatch_pct > 0.25% for 10m -> P3; escalate to P2 if >1% for 15m. target 2026-03-31.

omar: sample PromQL to track registrar-related errors:
```
sum(rate(registrar_update_errors_total[5m])) by (region)
```

_greta: sample gate check pseudo:_
```
# in deploy webhook
curl -s "https://edge-api.redwood.internal/route-status?expected=v57" | jq '.mismatch_count' 
# fail if mismatch_count / total_edges > 0.01
```

samir: LB guard notes: we'll add a check that sticky cookies are only reassigned if backend has matching route-version label. This prevents mapping to legacy pools. If guard fails in canary, automatic rollback.

vivian: customer communication plan: CS notified top 10 customers already with an initial summary. once canary passes we'll send an update with timeline + mitigation steps. cs-liaison, please coord.

cs-liaison: ack. I'll prepare a short blurb template and schedule an update email for after canary completion.

omar: vendor update: they suggested a staged-update API that can reduce peaks. I've activated sandbox access and will test tomorrow; ticket VND-4555 updated.

greta: smoke test checklist (to include in PRs):
- run synthetic from eu-central 20x -> expect X-RW-Route-Version == v57
- check `sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m]))` < 10 over 30m
- simulate registrar burst in sandbox and confirm registrar_update_errors_total remains < 0.01%
- run openssl handshake smoke and ensure session resume works: `openssl s_client -connect edge-proxy:443 -servername api.redwood.example -sess_out session.bin` then reconnect and `-sess_in session.bin` to validate resume

samir: I'll document rollback commands: revert lb-configmap, toggle sticky-cookie TTL back, and drain canary nodes. will post exact kubectl commands in PR.

vivian: ok final wrap: owners + dates:
- omar: registrar rate-smoothing + vendor test -> PR by 2026-04-05, sandbox test 2026-04-06
- greta: deploy gate webhook + PR -> 2026-04-02, canary gating on 2026-04-03
- samir: LB guard PR -> 2026-04-08, canary 2026-04-09
- cs-liaison: synthetic + alert + customer message -> 2026-03-31
- vivian: runbook + postmortem action list updated -> 2026-03-30

infra-bot: Calendar: follow-up check-in scheduled 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC.

cs-liaison: I'll post the customer blurb draft in #customer-updates for review.

omar: acked. starting vendor sandbox tests tomorrow.

greta: ack, will open PR and link here.

samir: ack, adding detailed tests to PR.

vivian: thanks everyone. I'll close the thread once all PR links and runbook are attached. Reopen if blockers pop up. :white_check_mark:
